description.zh:
模版类别。
- system: 系统
- customized: 自定义
description.en:
The category of the template. Valid values:

- system

- customized

description.zh: 搜索关键词。模板ID/名称，名称支持模糊搜索。
description.en: The search keyword. You can use the template ID or name as the keyword to search for templates. If you search for templates by name, fuzzy match is supported.
The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
排序，按CreateTime排序，默认是desc。

- asc - 正序
- desc - 倒序
description.en:
The sorting order. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order. Valid values:

- asc

- desc

description.zh:
模版类型。

- normal - 普通
- narrow-band - 窄高
- audio-only - 纯音频
- origin - 原画
description.en:
The type of the template. Valid values:

- normal

- narrow-band

- audio-only

- origin

description.zh:
视频编码。可选值：

- H.264
- H.265
description.en:
The video codec. Valid values:

- H.264

- H.265

title.zh: 获取实时媒体转码模版列表
